title: The Empire Has Ended: LNC 2024 Convention Recap
description:
We’re happy to release the long-awaited recap video from what can only be described as the most exciting, and talked about, Libertarian National Convention in our party’s history. 

From record-setting attendance, to new and popular entertainment acts, through to the highest profile speakers (and media coverage) to ever grace the stage at the Libertarian Convention, it was an unforgettable experience.
